class.name: ResourceTextSerializer
class.brief_description: Converts any [Resource] to JSON, INI or CSV text and back, based on its stored properties.

method.name: can_save_as_csv
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param resource] fits the CSV format: exactly one typed array of resources, elements of that type with only simple properties, and no other property that differs from its default value.

method.name: csv_to_resource
method.description: Creates a resource of the class [param type_hint] from CSV [param text]. The first row is the header with the property names of the list elements. The option [code]"delimiter"[/code] sets the delimiter (one character), the default comes from [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/resources/text_formats/csv_delimiter]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read.

method.name: dictionary_to_resource
method.description: Creates a resource from [param data], a [Dictionary] in the layout of [method resource_to_dictionary]. If [param data] has no [code]"$type"[/code] key, [param type_hint] gives the class. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if no resource can be created.

method.name: ini_to_resource
method.description: Creates a resource from INI [param text]. The class comes from the key [code]$type[/code] in the section [code][root][/code], or from [param type_hint]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read.

method.name: json_to_resource
method.description: Creates a resource from JSON [param text]. The class comes from the key [code]"$type"[/code] of the root object, or from [param type_hint]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read.

method.name: resource_to_csv
method.description: Returns [param resource] as CSV text. Options: [code]"delimiter"[/code] (one character) and [code]"enums_as_names"[/code] ([bool]). Returns an empty string and prints an error if the resource does not fit CSV (see [method can_save_as_csv]).

method.name: resource_to_dictionary
method.description: Returns [param resource] as a [Dictionary] that contains only JSON types ([Dictionary], [Array], [String], numbers, booleans and [code]null[/code]): the same layout as the JSON format. Option: [code]"enums_as_names"[/code] ([bool]).

method.name: resource_to_ini
method.description: Returns [param resource] as INI text. Options: [code]"plain"[/code] ([bool], values without type syntax) and [code]"enums_as_names"[/code] ([bool]).

method.name: resource_to_json
method.description: Returns [param resource] as JSON text. Options: [code]"indent"[/code] ([String], an empty string writes one line) and [code]"enums_as_names"[/code] ([bool]). Options that are not given come from the project settings under [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/[/code]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var compact = ResourceTextSerializer.resource_to_json(settings, { "indent": "", "enums_as_names": false }) [/gdscript] [csharp] string compact = ResourceTextSerializer.ResourceToJson(settings, new Godot.Collections.Dictionary { { "indent", "" }, { "enums_as_names", false } }); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

constants.constant: Version of the text layout. It is written as [code]"$format_version"[/code] into JSON files and into the INI section [code][root][/code]. A file with a higher version is read with a warning.
